folder.why: Masculine anglicism singular 'Folder' clashes with the feminine plural 'Carpetas' and g='f'; singular aligned to the same dictionary lemma (la carpeta / las carpetas). Mexican-register valid classroom term.

guinea-pig.why: Plural was a different lemma than the singular 'Cuyo'; plural must match the singular lemma (el cuyo / los cuyos, +s).
guinea-pig.src: WordReference: cuyo (noun sense = conejillo de Indias); regular +s

kite.why: Singular is Mexican 'Papalote' but plural was the Peninsular lemma 'Cometas'; plural must match the singular. Dict gives mpl papalotes.
'Papalote' is masculine (el papalote); the f gender came from the mismatched Peninsular 'cometa' (f).
